notes.title: Update instructions and future plans
notes.notes:
Update Description:

1. Re enable cloud archiving.

2. Delete two cheaters from the ranking.

3. In the puzzle workshop and the puzzle portrait, add more game default avatars, which can be selected in steam personal settings.

4. Modify the inconsistency between the cover and the title of the funny collage portrait (change the hand-painted portrait to portrait)




Content to be updated.

Then try to fix the bug again. It is now suspected that the filename is too long or the suffix is in a false format.



1,% as the first word of the file name, the picture cannot be read.

2. Locally import the file name that is too long (but it seems that not all jpgs and PNGS are triggered and have been tested personally), (it may be unnecessary to change the DLC subscription), restart the game, and all the pictures will disappear. (another player said that he encountered a file name that was too long and triggered a bug. The file became 0kb and could not be deleted.)

Group friend suggestion: if necessary, cut it off and then add numbers automatically? Filename + I or I++



Additional features are also being considered (depending on the situation.)

1. On all buttons, add a text description when the mouse passes.

2. When the puzzle is completed, click the completed picture to add the function of displaying the original size. You can drag with the left mouse button to facilitate the player to view. Double click or right-click to restore to the previous menu.

3. Change the thumbnail folder under pic to hide by default to avoid misoperation.

notes.title: Update description November 7th
notes.notes:
1, repair the BUG in the subscription workshop where the file name contains special symbols causing the suffix exception.

2, Upload sound effects. It can be closed.

notes.title: Update announcement October 31st
notes.notes:
1. Display the right and left page turning arrows immediately after completing any difficulty, no longer need to re-click the picture before the page turning key appears.



2. adjust the position of the scroll bar.



3. add scroll bar to mouse roller operation.



4. remove the image size limit, set the upper limit of the document to 3MB.

If there is a problem of program crashing, please delete the oversized picture. The collapse is due to machine configuration.



5. fix subscriptions to BUG that does not work well.

notes.title: October 29th update
notes.notes:
To update:

1, the upper limit is 5000X5000, 5MB (do not import a large number of ultra-high volume pictures, prone to program crash, depending on the configuration of personal computers).

2, add sound prompts when uploading successfully.

3, shield all buttons at the first boot, and force the click to boot.



Will be updated:

1, repair subscriptions that do not work well in BUG.

2, pull-down menu misalignment fine-tuning.

3, upload failure prompt.

4, BUG is not added to the default image when CTRL is added.

5, remove the size limitation of the file, using only volume limitation.

notes.title: Update October 26th
notes.notes:
Add batch uploading (hold CTRL+ mouse left key plus selection).

Add built-in novice boot.

The selected page is increased from 6 to 12.

Fixed BUG that was interrupted during uploading.

The reference diagram can be used to zoom in and out through the rollers.

Importing local images does not need to be restarted.

2 free DLC have been released.

加入批量上传（按住CTRL+鼠标左键加选）。
加入内置新手引导。
选图页面从6张提高到12张。
修复上传过程中被打断的BUG。
拼图中使用参考图可以通过滚轮缩放大小了。
导入本地图片不需要重新启动了。
2个免费DLC已发布。
